pay.noBank: No bank details set by staff yet.
pay.name: Name
pay.confirmCreateCommissionSub: Staff can be assigned to it afterward from the staff pay page.
pay.confirmSaveCommissionSub: This affects commissions for every staff member assigned to it going forward.
pay.autoNeedsHours: Auto claims need a minimum hours threshold.
pay.confirmCreateClaimSub: Staff will need to be marked eligible before they can submit against it.
pay.confirmSaveClaimSub: This updates the claim type and any eligibility changes made below.

cadenceSub.weekly: 1 week per period · paid every Monday
cadenceSub.bi_weekly: 2 weeks per period · 26 payouts a year
cadenceSub.four_weekly: 4 weeks per period · 13 payouts a year

pay.scheduleNote: Applies to every staff member. Payouts already marked paid are never changed.
pay.notTheDay: Not the day to change this
pay.notTheDaySub: {n} payout(s) have already been counted into this period, and it still has {days} day(s) to run. Changing now rewrites the window that pay was counted into. Wait until its last day, pay everyone, let the last store close, then switch.
pay.switchClean: Nothing has been counted into the current period yet, so this is a clean handover.
pay.switchLastDay: Today is the last day of the current period, so this is a clean handover — as long as everyone has been paid and every store has closed.
pay.switchCounted: The current period does not end for {days} more day(s), and {n} payout(s) have already been counted into it. Switching now rewrites the window that pay was counted into.
pay.switchOverlap: Note: that period starts before the current one ends, so it covers days the current period already counted.
pay.daysPendingSub: All commissions and claims must be reviewed before payment can be confirmed.
pay.alreadySub: Nothing left to confirm here. The payslip has the details.
pay.skipNote: Nothing was approved for this period, so no transfer is made. Closing it locks its commissions and claims the same way paying would.
pay.uploadFailed: Upload failed — tap to try again
pay.noteSkipHint: e.g. No shifts worked this fortnight
pay.notePayHint: e.g. Paid early for the holiday, includes W30 shortfall
pay.noteShownPay: Shown to {name} on their payslip. Can't be edited after payment.
pay.noteShownSkip: Shown to {name} on their payslip. Can't be edited after the period is closed.
pay.lockedPay: This period runs until its last day. It can be paid from that day, {n} day(s) from now.
pay.lockedSkip: This period runs until its last day. It can be closed from that day, {n} day(s) from now.
pay.confirmSkipSub: {name} is owed nothing for this period.
pay.recordsPay: The transfer screenshot, your name and today's date are saved to the payslip. The note cannot be edited afterwards.
pay.recordsSkip: The period closes with no transfer, against your name and today's date. Its commissions and claims can no longer be approved or rejected.
pay.noPeople: Nobody to pay in this period.
pay.noPayslip: Nothing for this person in this period.
pay.noPeopleBody: Payslips show here once a seller closes a day in this period.
pay.advancedNote: Rare settings. A change here affects every staff member's payday.
pay.helpPeriodBody:
Everyone is paid on the same schedule.
The arrows flip between periods.
The pay date is the day after a period ends.
pay.helpReviewBody:
Each closed day makes commissions; staff send claims.
A person shows what is still waiting.
Only approved amounts count towards their total.
pay.helpPayingBody:
Open a person to see the breakdown, then pay or skip.
Pay: saves the transfer screenshot and closes the period for them.
Skip: closes it with no transfer.
A paid or skipped period can no longer change.
pay.helpSetupBody:
Commission and claim types: in Pay Settings.
A person's commission and bank: on their page in People.
Pay schedule: in More, Advanced.
